model_classification.evidence_quote: We developed a pharmacokinetic model consisting of a maternal and a child compartment to simulate lifetime exposure in women and transfer to the child across the placenta and through breastfeeding.

connections.evidence: The model simulates transfer across the placenta and through breastfeeding.
Breastfeeding is an important route of PFAS excretion in mothers.
